flow.name: Sign In — Enter phone and request OTP
flow.notes: Page has heading 'Login' and subheading 'Rupeek Sales App'. The phone field has a +91 country prefix displayed separately — fill only the 10-digit number into the input. The Send OTP button is a full-width orange button. After clicking, the form transitions to an OTP input screen.

actions.label: phone number text input (the editable field next to the +91 country code prefix)
Send OTP — the full-width orange submit button at the bottom of the login card

assertions.label: OTP input field with placeholder 0000 or label Enter the 4 digit OTP

flow.name: Sign In — Enter OTP and login
flow.notes: Fill 4-digit OTP received via SMS, click Login. Redirected to dashboard or check-in screen. IMPORTANT: do not remove or patch the fill/click actions from this step — they are required every run.

assertions.label: any dashboard or check-in page content that confirms login redirect has completed (e.g. Check In link, Check Out banner, Today Schedule, or Check-In heading)

flow.name: Leads List — Navigate to Action Required tab
flow.notes: Navigate directly to leads list, bypassing check-in if the session already exists. Three tabs at top: Action Required, In Progress, Completed.

assertions.label: leads count label showing X of Y leads

flow.name: Leads List — Switch to In Progress tab
flow.notes: Clicking In Progress tab updates the URL to /leads/ongoing/IN_PROGRESS and reloads the list.

flow.name: Leads List — Switch to Completed tab
flow.notes: Clicking Completed tab updates the URL to /leads/ongoing/COMPLETED.

flow.name: Leads List — Switch back to Action Required tab
flow.notes: Return to the primary NOT_STARTED tab.

flow.name: Filter Panel — Open filter drawer
flow.notes: Filter icon is top-right beside the leads count label. Clicking it slides a filter drawer in from the right.

actions.label: Filter icon button at top right of leads list

assertions.label: Hot leads toggle switch inside filter drawer

flow.name: Filter Panel — Close filter drawer without applying
flow.notes: The X close icon is at the top-left of the filter drawer next to the 'Filter' heading. It is an SVG icon button — click it with force if needed. After closing, the filter drawer disappears and the leads list is visible again.

actions.label: X close button at the top-left of the filter drawer header, next to the text Filter

assertions.label: Action Required tab visible (filter drawer is now closed)

flow.name: Lead Detail — Open first lead card
flow.notes: Navigate to the leads list fresh, then tap the first visible lead card. The card is a pressable div containing a phone number and customer name. Do NOT click the top navigation bar, header logo, or any tab — only click on the lead card item in the scrollable list below the tabs. The lead card navigates to /leads/details/[id].

actions.label: the > chevron arrow or the phone number text (e.g. 9100000023) on the first lead card — this is the navigation target that opens the lead detail page

errorCases.name: Filter returns no leads — empty state shown
